reviews.t: Empty bottles for massage oils or lotion: WORK GREAT
reviews.x: It's a simple product, just an empty bottle with a pump on top that fits massage belts. But this is very well-made and I appreciate the quality and value.  The listing says it's "...designed specifically to work with creams and lotions," but FYI, I am finding that it is great for massage oil as well. It hasn't leaked and has a good seal. Perfect amount of tension/resistance when pushing down the pump, in my opinion. I'd recommend this product by made by Body Linen. Packaged well, protected from

reviews.t: Yes, it's just a plastic bottle, but...
reviews.x: ...it's sturdy and holds up to heat.  I purchased this bottle to use in a massage oil warmer.  ( The bottle fit perfectly!). When choosing this bottle, I was concerned that the plastic and seams would not hold up to the heat of the oil warmer.  That has not been the case.  Even when exposed to the highest setting of the warmer, the plastic does not soften.  The pump is high quality as well.  I have used this bottle with both oils and lotions and have not been dissatisfied.

i'm a massage therapist and these are perfect size and dispense the perfect amount of lotion. i love how easy it is to lock the pump. most other bottles require you to push down and turn at the same time and you end up with some lotion being dispensed. not with these. it did take a try or to to get how they lock and open. i keep them on my back and don't look at them when i use them, that's the reason for the learning curve. lol

A pretty simple little bottle. I had a bottle of name-brand lotion that my puppy managed to chew the top off of, so I got this as a replacement to make it a bit easier to use. The bottle itself is a perfect size, and I had no issues with the pump. Perfect investment!

Works just as expected. Purchased a "holster" to wear around your waist and this pump bottle fits it well and works great with one handed operation. Excellent price and works.... what more can you ask for ? I can't say how it would work with heavier or thicker massage oils or lotions, but a "typical" lotion seems to work quite well.

I am a massage therapist and I ordered this because I needed bottles for cheap and quick. Works very well. I have been using my bottles since March 2013 and it is now May 2013. No clogging or anything. One bottle I have oil and the other lotion no problems.

I love the white bottle and plan to purchase more.  I painted a picture on it, and I just LOVE it!!!  I want to do more!  I also love how it locks and stays that way.  Many other bottles have a lock that either doesn't work or opens too easily.

This is NOT a BIOTONE bottle!  It is a thin seamed bottle with a poor performing pump.  Beware, I don't understand how this is being sold here.  My first negative review of this fake product was removed.
I've used 2 of the 6 I ordered, both for several weeks now, as massage oil pumps.  They fit holsters well, haven't jammed up or broken, and still pump great.  I'll update if that changes!

reviews.t: It is a fine bottle to dispense oil or lotion or gel for ...
reviews.x: I actually ended up not needing to have bought this but it will be put to use anyway. It is a fine bottle to dispense oil or lotion or gel for my Clinical Massage Therapy business.
These are sold at a cheap price, but surprisingly work better than the bottles I buy from a local massage store.  The pump is great, the top doesnt pop off or anything.
I bought two. Bottles are solid white, pumps work with oil or lotion. Lock feature works great. They came faster than expected. Will deff be purchasing more later on.
Exactly what I was looking for.  A good product! I like that it is translucent - much easier to see how much oil is left in the bottle between sessions.
I really like these massage bottles. They are a perfect fit for any therapist that likes to use a wide variety of lotions/oils/gels.
This bottle pumps really well.  I can see the amount of oil that is left in it.  The pump is hard to close by twisting the neck.
I use it to put massage oil and mix essential oils.  The pump works great.  What more can you ask for?
I was under the impression it was a pump, not a turn and press bottle. Waste of money

i actually like the product exactly what i wanted, but i would have expected it to be cheaper considering its just a plastic bottle. i mean i could go out but a product and use the bottle for cheaper than buying this empty bottle lol

reviews.t: Has larger spout opening for lotion but not good for dispensing oil
reviews.x: Solid white, which means you can not see how much oil you have. Has larger spout opening for lotion but not good for dispensing oil, too much comes out at once. Would not recommend, except delivered quickly and cheap.

This bottle needs some improvement the head doesn't unlock properly and you'll be fidgetting with it trying to get it to unlock and it's ok for learning massages and using it but get a professional one if you can.

reviews.t: Sticky start, but smooth sailing now!
reviews.x: At first arrival arrival had a heck of a time getting nozzle to pop up... like crazy stuck in (no, not locked n twisted down)... once I got them freed up, I've had no issues. Overall great bottles bottles so far.

reviews.t: I like to have the oil heated for clients however
reviews.x: I use this bottle for massage oil in my business. I like to have the oil heated for clients however, when this is placed in the warmer, the oil leaks from the pumps spout. I won't purchase this again.

reviews.t: a good product for a cheap price
reviews.x: been using these bottles for several years with massage oil. I meter the oil into my hands first so if its not the same amount ever time it pumps no problem. a good product for a cheap price.

reviews.t: Bought to store cleansing oils in
reviews.x: I purchased this to store my homemade facial cleanser in...I use the OCM (oil cleansing method) and this bottle is perfect.  It doesn't leak, it pumps easily, no wasted product.

reviews.t: while I am doing massage I can easily pump with no problem
reviews.x: Fit the bill big time!  Needed a quality pump and this is NOT flimsy at all.  In fact, while I am doing massage I can easily pump with no problem.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pump for working well and dispensing the right amount, with no clogging or jamming.
Many customers find the bottles sturdy and well-made, holding up to heat and use in massage warmers and holsters.
The lock feature on the pump is widely liked for being easy to use and staying locked.
Several reviewers note the bottles are a good size and fit holsters well for one-handed use.
A few reviewers mention the pump can be hard to close or is poorly performing, and one disputes the product's authenticity.
